channel.title: The Drill Down: Philadelphia Eagles
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Eagles at Cowboys
item.description: Thu 11/26 · 4:30 PM ET | Line: DAL -8.5 · O/U 47.5 | Model DAL 77% vs. market 79% | Philadelphia's protection has to hold against a Dallas pass rush that pressures 25% of dropbacks, and that gap matters because the Eagles already allow pressure on 23%. CeeDee Lamb is the target to watch against Philadelphia's secondary, since he commands 33% of Dallas targets and faces a pass defense ranked 16th. Our model puts Dallas at 77 percent, a little under the market's 79, and the starting quarterback accounts for the largest share of that lean.

item.title: Week 11: Steelers at Eagles
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: PIT -4.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model PHI 37% vs. market 35% | Pittsburgh's ground game is the pressure point, since the Steelers lead the league in EPA per designed run and the Eagles' run defense ranks 16th, so Philadelphia must bottle it up before play-action opens. Jaylen Warren, first in rushing yards over expected at +2.1 per carry, is the back who has to turn that edge into first downs. Our model agrees with the market on Pittsburgh, and the rushing matchup, worth 6.2 points, drives most of our number.
